stemMarkdown: Find the difference (in Rs.) between the compound interest and the simple interest on Rs. 7000 at 5% per annum for 2 years. (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: CI: the amount after 2 years is $7717.50$, so CI $= 717.50$. SI $= \dfrac{7000 \times 5 \times 2}{100} = 700.00$. The difference is $17.5$.
altSolutionMarkdown: For 2 years the gap is always the interest earned on the first year's interest: $P\left(\dfrac{R}{100}\right)^2 = 7000 \times \left(\dfrac{5}{100}\right)^2 = 17.5$.
